test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B together can complete a work in 20 days. B and C together can complete the same work in 15 days. If A, B and C all work together, then the same work gets completed in 10 days. How many days will A and C together take to complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete a work in 20 days.

B and C together can complete the same work in 15 days.

A, B and C all work together, then the same work gets completed in 10 days.

**Concept Used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM(20, 15, 10) = 60 units

Efficiency of A and B together = 60/20 = 3 .......(i)

Efficiency of B and C together = 60/15 = 4 ........(ii)

Efficiency of A, B and C together = 60/10 = 6. .......(iii)

Solve (i) and (iii)

Efficiency of C = 6 - 3 = 3

Put in (ii)

Efficiency of B = 4 - 3 = 1

Put in (i)

Efficiency of A = 3 - 1 = 2

Efficiency of A + C = 3 + 2 = 5

A and B together can complete a work = 60/5 = 12 days

**A and C together take to 12 days complete the same work.**
